title: Rewrite slides.md as a thin table of contents
description:
## Objective
slides/slides.md becomes headmatter, one title slide, and five src: imports. Nothing else.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-foundation/2026-08-13-deck-foundation-spec.md` — Section: "1. Rewrite slides.md"

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/slides.md` — full rewrite

## Implementation
1. Headmatter: theme default, title, info, mdc true. No transition, no theme change — 01.3 owns those.
2. Title slide: '# How DevMeta Works' plus a one-line subtitle.
3. Five src: import blocks, in order 01-problem to 05-setup. Leave each block body empty.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build`
Do NOT close until it exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run build exits 0
